ConnectionStrings.//: Set with 'dotnet user-secrets set' in development, or the ConnectionStrings__SaadsShop environment variable in production. Never committed.

Jwt.//SigningKey: At least 32 bytes, from user-secrets or Jwt__SigningKey. Startup fails if this is missing or a known placeholder.

Google.//: Leave blank to run without Google sign-in; the endpoint then answers 404.
